defs.meaning: 美国联盟（American League）；美国军团（American Legion）；阿尔巴尼亚（Albania, 欧洲一国家名）；美国亚拉巴马州（Alabama）

examples.en: After a pause Al said sharply: "I'm sorry if I've upset you."
examples.zh: 停了一下之后艾尔突然说：“如果我让你不安了，我很抱歉。”

examples.en: His real name was Sabri al-Banna, but he became widely known by his nom de guerre, Abu Nidal.
examples.zh: 他的真名是萨布里-爱版纳，但以他的化名阿布-尼达尔广为人知。

examples.en: "What if there is no kerosene this winter?" said Al.—"So what?" she said. "We still have electricity."
examples.zh: “今年冬天如果没有煤油可怎么办呢？”阿尔说。—“那又怎么样？”她说。“我们还有电呢。”
